The clustering results revealed two distinct combustion modes.
The red cluster in the scatter plot corresponded to the shear layer combustion mode.
The shear layer combustion mode is characterized by narrow, stratified flame structures forming along the fuel–air interface.
This could be observed in the circled regions of Figure 8(d)(e), where the OH field intensity was concentrated along a thin horizontal band.
The yellow cluster corresponded to the jet-wake combustion mode.
In the jet-wake combustion mode, the flame emerged directly from the fuel inlet and formed a broad, curved tail.
This was evident in the circled regions of Figure 8(a)(b), where a large flame wake propagated along the upper part of the field.
